findings.title: Homepage real-code viewer is present but zero-height
steps: Scroll to Real paths. Real code. No screenshots.
findings.observed: The code card contains real code but computes to height 0 at desktop and mobile, so no selected code is visible.
findings.expected: The selected real-code artifact remains visible and updates after package selection.
findings.ruleSource: Caisson DESIGN.md artifact-is-the-headline rule; Refero Oxide/Warp reference lock; behavior rubric observable transition

findings.title: Docs skip link has no target and document has no main landmark
steps: Open docs in a clean session
Press Tab to focus Skip to content
findings.observed: The hash changes to #main-content, but no target or main landmark exists and focus/scroll do not bypass the docs chrome.
findings.expected: A single main landmark owns #main-content and receives the skip-link transition.
findings.ruleSource: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 and 2.4.1; Impeccable accessibility; Caisson AA floor

findings.title: Marketplace compare controls fail WCAG target size
findings.observed: The checkbox is 13x13px and its safe clickable area remains 13px because it overlaps the full-card preview action.
findings.expected: Each compare control provides at least a 24x24px safe target and preferably the 44px Caisson touch target.

findings.title: Docs search loses focus when dismissed
findings.observed: The dialog closes and focus moves to BODY instead of the Open Search trigger.
findings.expected: Dismissal returns focus to the control that opened the dialog.
findings.ruleSource: WCAG 2.2 2.4.3; Impeccable product register and behavior rubric focus-return requirement

findings.title: Docs GitHub SVG lacks accessible text
steps: Inspect the docs navigation accessibility tree
findings.observed: A GitHub SVG has role img without title, aria-label, or aria-labelledby.
findings.expected: The icon is decorative or has an accessible name consistent with its link.
findings.ruleSource: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1; Impeccable accessibility names and roles

findings.title: Mobile controls systemically miss the 44px Caisson target
steps: Measure visible links, buttons, and form controls
findings.observed: Shell controls are 36px, docs controls 34px, carousel arrows 32px, and many CTAs 40px tall.
findings.expected: Interactive hit areas reach the 44px internal target without visually inflating compact controls.
findings.ruleSource: Impeccable responsive audit touch-target rule; Caisson accessibility credibility principle

findings.title: WebGL-unavailable fallback logs repeated renderer errors
steps: Open homepage where WebGL context allocation fails
findings.observed: Content remains usable, but Three.js logs repeated context creation errors and Lighthouse best-practices falls to 92.
findings.expected: Capability detection preserves the poster fallback without repeated renderer errors.
findings.ruleSource: Caisson poster-first ambient-field contract; Impeccable performance and error-state discipline
